findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous eval/exec or dynamic code execution
 * @description Find uses of eval/exec and similar dynamic execution which could be dangerous if exposed to untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dynamic-code-execution-typing-inspection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of dynamic code execution (eval/exec). Review to ensure no untrusted input can reach here."
findings.hypothesis: Package might use eval/exec or similar dynamic execution for typing introspection, which could be dangerous if reachable with untrusted input.

message.text: Use of dynamic code execution (eval/exec). Review to ensure no untrusted input can reach here.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic code execution in typing_inspection
 * @description Find uses of eval/exec in typing_inspection package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dynamic-code-execution-typing-inspection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call, File f
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and
  f = call.getLocation().getFile() and
  f.getRelativePath().matches("src/typing_inspection/%")
select call, "Use of dynamic code execution (eval/exec). Review to ensure no untrusted input can reach here."
findings.hypothesis: The package uses eval/exec; we need precise locations to assess exploitability.
